reason: A DSH Web UI enhancement that detects hovered file paths and URLs and provides actions to reveal files in Explorer or open them in the default browser.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面中悬停文件路径或网址时，提供在资源管理器中显示或使用默认浏览器打开的操作。
summaries.en: Adds hover actions in the DSH Web UI to reveal file paths in Explorer or open paths and URLs with the default browser.

capabilities: Detects file paths and URLs in the DSH Web UI
Sends validated open requests to a local host route
Opens files or folders in the system file explorer
Opens URLs and file paths with the default browser
